title: 高价值流失风险客户
context: 运营希望针对长期未购买但历史价值高的客户。
requirements: 截至2025年底所有线上有效购买客户；历史订单数≥3、历史净金额排名前20%（NTILE(5)，按编号决胜）、最近90日无消费，输出历史毛利、最近购买距今天数和风险优先级（毛利降序）。
commonError: 仅凭最后消费日期无法识别高价值，且流失风险不是已流失事实。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) freq,MAX(order_date) last_day,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_cents-cost_cents) gross FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT *,NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY net DESC,customer_id) bucket FROM a) SELECT b.customer_id,freq,net net_cents,gross gross_cents,1095-d.day_index recency_days FROM b JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=b.last_day WHERE bucket=1 AND freq>=3 AND 1095-d.day_index>=90 ORDER BY gross DESC,b.customer_id
